title: Magnetic properties of rare earth clusters
claim: Locked-moment Gd and Tb clusters have internal moments per atom far below the bulk atomic moments, and those moments increase with applied field and with decreasing temperature.
explanation: Terbium locked-moment clusters span about 0.5 to nearly 4 μB per atom versus a bulk value of 9.25 μB per atom. Gadolinium locked-moment clusters span about 0.5 to 3 μB per atom versus a bulk value of 7.55 μB per atom. The same below-bulk conclusion is extended to the rare-earth clusters studied, including the superparamagnetic sizes.
scope: Locked-moment gadolinium and terbium clusters; the below-bulk statement in the conclusions covers the rare-earth clusters in this study.
conditions: Moments extracted from Stern-Gerlach profiles under the locked-moment model as field and temperature are varied.
caveats: Ranges are across sizes and conditions, not a single moment for every size. Dysprosium locked-moment moments are not given as a comparable range. Superparamagnetic moments are also below bulk but follow different temperature trends.
